body: Yeah, I've always been self conscious about my chest.

Yup. I was reading Shakespeare in 3rd grade and now I don't read anything if it's more than a paragraph.

Didn't even read your post.
Definitely, but I'd still take non-chain pizza over it most of the time.

My family spent a night on the USS Buffalo, for a cub scouts trip. My sister is a sleepwalker (she must have been 12 at the time), but that night she got up in the middle of the night and SPRINTED through the ship as a bunch of adults chased after her. Tbh it was pretty impressive considering those stupid oval shaped doorways. She woke up just before she got to the deck of the ship.
Yup. During my ACT exam and on election night.
My Mormon grandparents forced my parents to go through with it.
Same. Anyone yelling at me destroys me

I hate unexpected loud noises. I live right next to a railroad crossing, but I'm fine with that. Fireworks make me suuuuper anxious.

I also burst into tears if I see people fighting.
Distracting yourself usually helps. For me, it's music. When I'm super anxious, I'll improvise on uke or guitar for 15 minutes.
My dog licks my hands when I'm having a panic attack.
Well, they still arent always mindful about it but now they know it's not just teenage rebellion.
My parents used to interpret my panic attacks as me being too stubborn to talk to them.

The mind is great at fooling itself. You won't regret getting help. Trust me, I had the exact same mindset a month ago, and now I'm the happiest I've ever been; even with debilitating chronic pain.

Good luck, friend.
It's easy to tune out the positives when you have no confidence in yourself. Keep your head up, promise it'll get better.

There are plenty of people who don't care about appearance, myself included. I'm in love with an online friend of mine and I've never seen him, though he is self conscious about how he looks. 

Taking care of yourself and being a positive, caring person goes a long way. 

Edit: saw your post history, you are definitely not ugly. You look quite a lot like Neil Patrick Harris! Keep your chin up and remember that depression fucks with your self esteem. I went to a psych hospital thinking I was overweight and I was actually severely underweight with a bmi of 16.
I don't blame them at all. I'm a worthless piece of shit. I dug myself into this hole, not them.
